Perseverance sab jeet leti hai.
Character destiny banata.
Tumhari ekmatra seema tumhari kalpana hai.
"Success ki seedhi top pe kabhi crowd nahi hoti."
Motivation start karati hai, discipline grow karwati hai.
Taqat majboot iraade se aati hai.
Caution wisdom nahi—boldness se act chahiye.
Koshish nahi karoge toh kabhi nahi jeetoge.
Goal bina plan, sirf wish hai.
"Jeetna sab kuch nahi, par win karna chahna hai."
Cheezon ko dekhne ka tarika badlo, cheezein khud badal jaayengi.
